# Phase 6 Capacity Evidence

Use separate additive records for plan validation results, vehicle capacity snapshots and future-capacity assumptions. Keep snapshots tied to a plan version's review context rather than mutating vehicle master data; keep feasibility logic in services and enforce only safe numeric invariants in PostgreSQL. Label illustrative scenarios with `DEMO-` source IDs and disclose that they are not forecasts or official competition data.
